tasks.title: Edit overlay: validate and merge edits, build the edited view of an audit version
tasks.description: Pure core module for REQ-020 (Q-25: originals kept, edits are an overlay). `packages/core/src/audit/documents/edits.ts` exports: `emptyOverlay()`, `validateAuditEditsPatch(body)` (shape of `AuditEditsPatch` from `packages/types/src/website-audit.ts:738`, text caps, unknown keys refused, returns field errors), `mergeEditsPatch(overlay, patch, now)` (adds/replaces/resets finding, section and recommendation edits, remove/restore pages, proposal inputs; sets `updatedAt`), and `buildEditedView(result, contents, overlay)` returning the read model every document builder uses: removed pages dropped from `pages`, the hierarchy (children re-parented to the removed node's parent), navigation links, leaving-site `from` lists, internal-linking counts, findings (findings only on removed pages dropped; removed pages stripped from `pages`), roadmap items left without findings dropped; finding title/detail/suggestion and Section text replaced by edits; recommendation action replaced. Never mutates `result`, `contents` or `overlay`. Also owns the shared test fixture `packages/core/tests/helpers/audit-doc-fixture.ts` (a small finished `AuditResult` with English and Tamil `PageContent`, findings on several pages and Sections, a roadmap, recommendations) that the other document tasks import.
acceptance_criteria: Given a finding edit (title, detail or suggestion), when the edited view is built, then the finding carries the edited text and the original `AuditResult` object is unchanged (deep-equal to its copy taken before).

Given a page removed from the hierarchy, when the edited view is built, then that urlPath appears nowhere in the view: not in pages, hierarchy nodes, navigation links, leaving-site sources, internal-linking counts, finding pages or roadmap pages; its child pages stay, re-parented to its parent.
Given a Section edit, when the edited view is built, then that Section's text is the edited text and every other Section's text is unchanged character for character (Tamil included).
Given a patch with `reset: true` for a finding, Section or recommendation, when merged, then the edit is removed and the original shows again; `restorePages` brings a removed page back.
Given an invalid patch (wrong types, unknown keys, text over the cap, malformed urlPath), when validated, then it is refused with per-field errors and nothing is merged.
expected_outputs: packages/core/src/audit/documents/edits.ts with validateAuditEditsPatch, mergeEditsPatch, buildEditedView
Shared fixture packages/core/tests/helpers/audit-doc-fixture.ts
Unit tests covering REQ-020 AC-1..AC-3 at the model level

tasks.title: PDF (Playwright print) and Word (.docx) renderers plus a dependency-free zip writer
tasks.description: No new npm dependency (checked: core has `playwright` 1.63.0 and `mammoth` 1.12.3 (read-only docx); no zip or docx writer exists in any package.json). `zip.ts`: minimal ZIP writer on `node:zlib` (`deflateRawSync`, `crc32`, Node 22) with sorted, sanitized entry names (no `..`, no absolute paths), used for .docx and the export bundle. `render-pdf.ts`: `renderPdf(html, { format: 'A4' })` launches Chromium via the existing `playwright` dependency, `page.route('**/*')` aborts every request that is not `data:` (the document is self-contained, ADR 0021), `setContent` then `page.pdf({ format: 'A4', printBackground: true })`, always closes the browser, honours a timeout. `render-docx.ts`: `renderDocx(docs)` writes WordprocessingML from BE-501's block model (headings as Heading1..3 styles, paragraphs, lists, tables, embedded PNG/JPEG images, page breaks between documents), `w:lang` per language and run fonts with `w:cs` set to a Tamil-capable font ('Nirmala UI', fallback 'Latha') for complex-script text. Node-only module: never imported by the wizard.
acceptance_criteria: Given rendered documents, when exported as Word, then a valid .docx is produced and `mammoth` (existing dependency) reads back every heading, paragraph and table cell of the same documents (REQ-022 AC-2).
Given Tamil documents, when exported as Word, then the text read back equals the source character for character and runs carry `w:lang` ta-IN and a complex-script Tamil font.
Given rendered HTML, when exported as PDF, then a file starting `%PDF-` is produced, with A4 page size, containing the same documents (REQ-022 AC-1).
Given Tamil HTML, when exported as PDF, then the PDF embeds a font that covers Tamil (font program present, name matching the declared Tamil font stack) (supports REQ-022 AC-3).
Given HTML referencing an external URL, when printed, then no request leaves the process (the route handler aborted it) and the browser is closed even when printing fails or times out.
Given zip entries, when written, then names are sanitized and the archive is readable (round-trip through the docx reader proves it).
tasks.validation_waiver: REQ-022 AC-3 visual part: a person opens one Tamil PDF and one Tamil .docx (in Word or LibreOffice on Windows) generated from the audit-site fixture and confirms no missing-glyph boxes and correct Tamil conjuncts; automated tests only prove the font is embedded or declared.
expected_outputs: renderPdf, renderDocx, writeZip
audit-doc-pdf added to BROWSER_TESTS.core by G7
